# Phosphor icons used by Reffi

Source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/swift at `9a9467181782bbe319ad4935d0993c77cd8a5fbc` (MIT).

Only icons referenced by Reffi are included. The six upstream weights are preserved. SVG paths were converted to vector PDF with svg-to-pdfkit, removing the large SVG compilation step from app builds. The public Swift API and icon names are unchanged.

The bundled LICENSE applies to the Swift code and icons. To add an icon, include its enum case and six vector assets from this pinned upstream version.
